title: MZ Help with MOG_BattleResult for MZ

posts.author: Sundriedfetum
posts.body:
I'm trying to use the MOG_BattleResult plugin in RPG Maker MZ. Although the plugin was originally made for MV, it works fine in MZ when using the default Turn-Based battle system. However, when I switch to either Time Progress (Active) or Time Progress (Wait), the battle gets stuck and won't continue.
I've tested this in a brand new project with only the MOG_BattleResult plugin installed, and the issue still happens.
How can i fix this?
